feature: Left nav: distinguish "M365 Health" (the overall rollup page) from "Health" (the pillar, ex-Architecture) by nesting the 6 pillar items under an "M365 Health" collapsible group in app-shell.tsx, instead of both sitting flat with near-identical labels.
notes: Selectors: every sidebar nav item now carries a stable data-testid derived from its href (`sidebar-nav-<href-without-slashes>`), e.g. `sidebar-nav-m365-health` for the parent and `sidebar-nav-architecture` for the pillar formerly labeled the same 'Health' -- the point of this fix is that these are no longer flat siblings sharing a near-identical label.
The group starts expanded by default; the toggle (`sidebar-m365-health-group-toggle`) collapses/expands the children wrapper (`sidebar-m365-health-children`).

Collapsed (icon-only) sidebar mode intentionally flattens the group back to a plain icon list (no room for indentation/labels there) -- not covered here since collapsed-sidebar toggling isn't itself part of this issue's scope.
